title: Cannon Green

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: We offer a combination of options, with indoor and outdoor settings. Host a casual luncheon for 20, a private dinner for 50, or an evening business reception for 250. We offer a range of options including cocktail gatherings designed for social interaction and mingling, comfortable and informal family-style dining, creative themed food stations, as well as formal two and three course seated dinner celebrations. Cannon Green is built to accommodate large events easily. Our signature events space, the Trolley Room offers the perfect setting for your large group to gather.
